justification: Fix 3 unsafe bracket accesses on external API dicts (KeyError risk) + add pre-commit lint hook to prevent new instances.

pre_impl.existing_data: Valuation history (NSW Valuation API), nearby DAs (ePlanning API), FIRMS hotspots (NASA API)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: API responses may omit expected keys — bracket access crashes, .get() returns None safely
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Code fix applies to all requests immediately. Lint only checks new staged lines.

functions.name: _build_economics
functions.input: dict from NSW Valuation Service API via _fetch_valuation
functions.output: EconomicProfile with ValuationHistory list — h.get('value') replaces h['value']
functions.if_none: h.get('value') returns None, int(None) skipped by truthiness guard — safe

functions.name: _build_neighbourhood
functions.input: list[dict] from ePlanning DA API via _fetch_nearby_das
functions.output: NeighbourhoodContext with NearbyDA list — d.get('lodgement_date','') replaces d['lodgement_date']
functions.if_none: d.get('lodgement_date','') returns empty string, str('')[:10] = '' — safe

functions.name: check_line
functions.input: filepath, lineno, line text from git diff staged output
functions.output: list of violation strings — empty if line is clean
functions.if_none: No None inputs possible — all from string processing

values.if_missing: ValuationHistory.value = None — displayed as N/A in frontend

values.nullable: yes — returns empty string as default
values.if_missing: Falls back to d.get('lodged') which is the primary key — correct

break_it.scenario: Lint false-positive on psycopg2 DictRow bracket access (row['column'])
break_it.how: SAFE_VARS allowlist includes 'row', 's', 'r', 'rec'. Also supports # noqa: bracket-access

break_it.scenario: Lint misses bracket access on variable not in its regex (e.g. CamelCase vars)
break_it.what_happens: Unsafe bracket access on external dict goes undetected by lint
break_it.how: Python convention: all local variables are snake_case. Regex [a-z_][a-z0-9_]* covers all standard vars
break_it.repro: Services codebase uses snake_case consistently — verified via grep

break_it.scenario: NSW Valuation API returns history entry with value=0 (falsy but valid)
break_it.what_happens: h.get('value') is 0 which is falsy — int(0) branch skipped, value set to None
break_it.how: Pre-existing issue, not introduced by this fix. Would need explicit 'is not None' check.
break_it.repro: Pass valuation with val_history=[{'year':'2020','value':0}] — value becomes None
